svg.title: Village Link All Pages Wireframe
svg.desc: Black and white page-by-page wireframe sheet for the Village Link courier and parcel tracking system.

g.text: Black and white wireframe pages for presentation: public site, customer, agent, admin, and support flows.
Customer can report parcel delivery issues.
Who We Are / What We Do

Presentation flow: Landing -> Register/Login -> Customer Dashboard -> Book Parcel -> Track Parcel -> Payment -> Invoice -> Complaints/AI -> Agent Dashboard -> Admin Dashboard -> Public Services/About/Contact -> Reports.
